get.summary: Export all personal data for employee under GDPR Art. 15/20
Get a configured employee timesheet
Labour Inspectorate working-time record (TIM-006) for one employee or the organization, as JSON, CSV or PDF
get.description: Every format carries the same export id and content hash (SHA-256 of the CSV body, every line before the final `# sha256=` line, without the BOM), also sent as the X-Export-Id and X-Content-SHA256 headers. Each employee's days and clock times are in that employee's time zone (location, else organization), named on every row; the header zone is the organization's. Each successful export is written to the audit log (ADM-002). Limited to 10 requests per minute per user and client address.

200.description: Inspection export. Headers: X-Export-Id, X-Content-SHA256, Cache-Control: no-store; csv and pdf are sent as attachments.

400.description: Invalid query (dates, period over 366 days, format or locale)

403.description: Employee or organization outside the caller's scope

422.description: EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: organization export over OFFICIAL_EXPORT_MAX_EMPLOYEE_DAYS (employees × days); request a shorter period

get.summary: Employees the caller may export (TIM-006, TIM-008) for a period, for the export's employee picker
get.description: Requires time.record.read at any scope. Organization scope (admin, auditor) lists every employee of the organization employed during the period (the same set as an organization export); reports scope (manager) lists self and direct reports; self scope lists only the caller. Id and display name only, sorted by name. A caller with organization-wide time access but no employee.read (an inspector) gets one inspector.export_picker_access audit entry per call (TIM-008). Limited to 60 requests per minute per user and client address.

400.description: Invalid dates or period over 366 days
